profile.summaryLine: Laura is a 46-year-old dental hygienist with a complex cancer and cardiac history who prefers detailed, numbers-based explanations tailored to her situation.

emotionalContext.text: Laura works in healthcare and wants to receive the numbers, but also wants clear explanations of what those numbers mean for her personally.
emotionalContext.reason: She directly stated her communication preference in her check-in.

emotionalContext.text: She is currently asymptomatic from her cancer and cardiac conditions.
emotionalContext.reason: Recent notes document her as asymptomatic.

emotionalContext.text: Laura has experienced bothersome menopausal symptoms that have disrupted her sleep and daily activities.

privacyRules.rule: Do not include the names of cancer diagnoses, psychiatric diagnoses, or related medications in SMS messages.
privacyRules.reason: To protect privacy regarding sensitive cancer history and medications in SMS.

strengths.text: Laura is a healthcare professional, suggesting strong baseline health literacy and comfort with medical information.
strengths.reason: Her occupation is documented as dental hygienist.

strengths.text: She is proactive in her care, asking about new screening tests and following up on symptoms.
strengths.reason: She inquired about ovarian cancer screening and reports symptoms as they arise.

dataQualityWarnings: Age is inconsistently documented as 46 and 47 in different encounters.
